explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1133. For every C > 0 there is ε > 0 such that, for large n and any nodes x_i ∈ [-1,1], some values y_i ∈ [-1,1] force every polynomial of degree < (1+ε)n that matches at least (1-ε)n of them to exceed C somewhere on [-1,1]. Nodes may repeat, which can only make the statement easier, and the docstring notes that Yang's theorem covers that case. The solved status rests on Yang [Ya26] (arXiv:2609.14769), which I did not independently check, but the formal statement is a faithful transcription.
